title: The 1-1-1 Framework
equation: Growth Clarity = Focus × Repetition × Diagnosis Speed
hook: Five traffic sources and three offers feels like growth. Mostly it's noise you can't diagnose.
statement: Grow faster by committing to one traffic source, one way to convert, and one delivery channel before adding more.
explainer: When there's only one of each, you can see the leak fast. Leads but no sales means conversion's broken. Sales but unhappy clients means delivery is.
sop: Pick one conversion method, like a sales call or a landing page.
Score Focus, Repetition, and Diagnosis Speed from 1 to 10 every week.
Add complexity only after the simple version works.
equation_example: Focus 9, Repetition 7, Diagnosis Speed 8. 9 × 7 × 8 = 504 Growth Clarity. Higher means you spot and fix problems fast. Running five channels at once tanks Focus and Diagnosis Speed, even if things look busy.
question: Write down your one traffic source, one conversion method, and one delivery channel for the next 90 days.
closing_statement: One working channel beats five untested ones.
caption:
Principle Nº 244: The 1-1-1 Framework

Five traffic sources and three offers feels like growth. Mostly it's noise you can't diagnose.

Grow faster by committing to one traffic source, one way to convert, and one delivery channel before adding more.

Your turn: Write down your one traffic source, one conversion method, and one delivery channel for the next 90 days.
